extensionDescription.message: Open the YouTube video you select in your ZeloteZ Rooms instance.

privacyNote.message: The extension uses the video ID you choose and verifies this address before opening it. You sign in to Rooms itself.

desktopNote.message: Open the desktop app, or continue in this browser if the app is unavailable.

invalidAddress.message: Enter the HTTPS address of your Rooms instance, without a path.

invalidInstance.message: This address could not be verified as a ZeloteZ Rooms instance.

incompatibleInstance.message: This Rooms instance uses an unsupported protocol version.

permissionRequired.message: Allow access to this address so the extension can verify your instance.

checkFailed.message: The Rooms address could not be checked. Try again.

launchFailed.message: ZeloteZ Rooms could not open. Try again or check your extension settings.
